scope: Exact read-only far block-cell / compound-proxy exclusion parity, bounded native pages and stable populated-world forest membership. Not universal seamless rendering or the full overhaul.
implementation: Original 0BSD native code and tests; existing archive worker and existing project dependencies only. No imported implementation or new external dependency.
worker_handoff: Immutable native shared payload; no custom Godot RefCounted object embedded in a cross-thread completion Variant. Script decoder wrapper remains separate. All teardown gates count live native payloads.

native_pressure.scope: Main-thread query time differs from asynchronous packet read/validation/BVH construction; packet/decode scratch and allocator overhead are separate from the cache cap.

installed_lifecycle.scope: One populated read-only fixture, scoped actual block streaming. Model admission parity is covered by native fixtures, not dense mixed-world endurance.

installed_lifecycle_repeat.scope: Same unchanged installed build, consecutive second two-world cold/warm lifecycle run; no builds or other automated game tests overlapped.

earlier_candidate.scope: Retained earlier image and passing samples, not lifetime qualification; repeated later runs exposed the retained payload before the native handoff replacement.

isolated_installed_road_sweep.scope: Controlled camera-speed road sweep, no concurrent native build/test workload. Forest coverage stays complete, but local ground-cover owners can still lag. These are residency diagnostics, not measured pixel gaps. Not physical driving or hardware-minimum qualification.
